headline: Friday morning: Dhaka 7th in global air pollution ranking
summary: The capital city faces severe air quality issues as it ranks among the top ten most polluted cities globally.
details: Dhaka was ranked 7th in the global air pollution index on Friday morning.
The city continues to struggle with high levels of pollutants, affecting the health of millions of residents.
Jakarta was reported as the most polluted city globally at the time of the ranking.
The persistent smog and poor air quality in the capital are attributed to various urban and industrial factors.

headline: Mexico beats South Korea 1-0 to qualify for World Cup last 32
summary: Luis Romo's second-half goal secures Mexico's place in the knockout stage as they win Group A.
details: Mexico defeated South Korea 1-0 in the World Cup on Thursday, securing their place in the knockout stage and winning Group A.
The decisive goal came five minutes into the second half, scored by Luis Romo after a costly error by South Korean goalkeeper Kim Seung-gyu.
Goalkeeper Kim failed to gather a cross after colliding with a teammate, allowing Romo to volley the ball into an unguarded net.
Despite the loss, Kim later made several saves, including one to deny Raul Jimenez, to help limit the damage.
Mexican goalkeeper Raul Rangel also played a crucial role, stopping a late attempt from Yang Hyun-jun to preserve the clean sheet.
Mexico now finishes with six points to qualify as Group A winners, while South Korea finishes with three points.
Mexico will face the Czech Republic at the Estadio Azteca on Wednesday,
caption:
Mexico is the first team to qualify for the World Cup knockout stage! 🇲🇽

Mexico defeated South Korea 1-0 in the World Cup on Thursday, securing their place in the knockout stage and winning Group A.

The decisive goal came five minutes into the second half, scored by Luis Romo after a costly error by South Korean goalkeeper Kim Seung-gyu.

Goalkeeper Kim failed to gather a cross after colliding with a teammate, allowing Romo to volley the ball into an unguarded net.

Despite the loss, Kim later made several saves, including one to deny Raul Jimenez, to help limit the damage.

Mexican goalkeeper Raul Rangel also played a crucial role, stopping a late attempt from Yang Hyun-jun to preserve the clean sheet.

Mexico now finishes with six points to qualify as Group A winners, while South Korea finishes with three points.

Mexico will face the Czech Republic at the Estadio Azteca on Wednesday,

#WorldCup #Mexico #SouthKorea #Football #GroupA

Source: Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com, Somoy News
